# Peit — AI ჩატბოტი ქართული ბიზნესისთვის

> Peit არის SaaS პლატფორმა, რომელიც აყენებს AI ჩატბოტს ვებსაიტზე, Telegram-ში, Instagram-სა და Facebook Messenger-ში. პასუხობს კლიენტების კითხვებს ბუნებრივ ქართულად 24/7, კვალიფიცირებს ლიდებს და CRM-ში ანახლებს.

## What Peit Does

- **AI chatbot for SMBs in Georgia (country)** — natural Georgian, English, and Russian
- **Multi-channel deployment** — Website widget, Telegram, Instagram, Facebook Messenger
- **10-minute setup** — paste your website URL, Peit auto-crawls and learns
- **Lead capture** — collects name, contact, intent → exports to CSV / sends to email / CRM
- **24/7 operation** — replies in ~0.8s average

## Target Industries

- E-commerce (online shops)
- Restaurants / cafes / delivery
- Hotels and hospitality
- Beauty salons and spas
- Medical clinics
- Real estate agencies
- Fitness clubs
- Education platforms
- SaaS startups

## Pricing (parseable)

See [/pricing.md](https://peit.vercel.app/pricing.md) for structured plan data AI agents can compare.

## Tech / Architecture

- Built on Next.js 16 + Drizzle ORM + Postgres (pgvector for RAG retrieval)
- AI: Claude Haiku for natural conversation, Voyage AI embeddings
- Billing: Lemon Squeezy (Merchant of Record — handles VAT globally)
- Auth: Clerk
- Deployment: Vercel

## Who's Behind Peit

Founded in Georgia (country) in 2026. Designed specifically for Georgian SMBs that need customer support automation in Georgian without paying enterprise prices.
